name: Algonauts Project 2025 / CNeuroMod audiovisual movie fMRI challenge data

stimulus.rights: Review stimulus/media rights separately from the challenge neural-data license before any commercial training use.

license.commercialEligibility: Neural/challenge data is permissive; stimulus rights remain a separate provenance gate.

splitPolicy: Use subject/stimulus-aware held-out evaluation. Never tune hyperparameters on the final test set.
notes: The first BrainSNN benchmark should use fixed/precomputed features so the objective can be validated cheaply on CPU.
Track feature-model and stimulus licensing independently in every experiment record.
TRIBE v2 is a research reference only and is not a source of commercial labels for this pipeline.
